༄༅/ /klu gtor gtong tshul gyi yi ge dgos 'dod char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/'dir klu gtor gtong ba'i tshul nya

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /klu gtor gtong tshul gyi yi ge dgos 'dod char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ 'dir klu gtor gtong ba'i tshul nyams su blang ba la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ 'khar ba dang / bse dang / lcags ma yin pa'i snod dri ma med pa chu gtsang gis bkang ba la/ ba dmar mo'i 'o ma dang / klu sman gyi rigs mang po gong ma'i gsung rab dang / klu'i dpa' skong sogs nas bshad pa ltar sna gang 'dzoms zhib bar btags pa dang / dar sna tshogs kyi dum bu gtsang ma gang 'byor rnams btab pa bsham ste/ 'di ni klu rnams kyi nad sna tshogs zhi bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi khrus kyi rdzing bu yin no/ /gzhan yang snod ji ltar rigs par phud phye gtsang ma brdzis pa'i bla ma dkon mchog spyi la 'bul pa'i lha bshos gcig klu rnams la 'bul rgyu'i sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / sngags 'chang chen po yab sras kyi phyag len bzhin zan ril drug cu rtsa bzhi bcos pa bzhag rang ngam grogs gzhan yod na de'i mdun du gtor stegs kyi 'gor lha bshos bzhag de nas gtor theb lnga tshar rin po che'am/ rdza la sogs pas byas pa'i nang du gong du bzos pa'i zan ril nas gtor theb re rer ril bu bzhi bzhi bcug pa 'o ma dang / chu gtsang klu sman gsum bsres pas sbyangs pa bsham mo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ skyabs 'gro spyi dang mthun pa lan nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa bya zhing / bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che/ sogs dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sogs brjod pas stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid hrīḥyig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'dir ni bdag bskyed bsdus pa la dga' ba'i dbang du byas pa yin zhing /

cung zad rgyas pa la spro na sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i klu gtor gtong tshul gyi yi ge gsal byed sgron me nas 'byung ba ltar gyi spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra'i bsgom bzlas de bzhin nyams su blang ba gyis shig 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin dang / g.yon pas pad+ma'i sdong bu thugs khar 'dzin pa/ zhabs skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer du ma 'phro ba/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng du hriḥyig sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ khyad par du yang sa bdag klu gnyan la sogs pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ sangs rgyas byang sems la sogs pa thams cad spyan drangs te thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng la thim/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes pa brgya stong la sogs pa bzlas la/ de nas/ oṃ ar+ya lo ki shwa ra oṃ badz+ra ar+gham̐ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pa d+yam̐ sogs kyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa sa bdag klu gnyan la sogs pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang / myur du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes dkar cha bzhi chag med byed bzhin pa yin na/ skabs 'dir bya zhing gzhan rnams dkyus bzhin las sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma mi mdzad/ gsol ba btab nas mdun gyi mchod rdzas bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rdzas rnams dang / de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/

slar yang yig 'bru rnams 'od du zhu ba sngar gyi rdzas rnams dang 'dres pas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ces dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nyer gcig brjod/ gnas yid du 'ong ba rin po che'i brag ri dang / mtsho dang / rdzing bu dang / ne'u sing dang / pho brang dang / skye mos tshal la sogs pa rnams su gang 'dod pa'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang / klu nad thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen pos yongs su gang bar gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas mgron bskyed pa ni/ gtor ma las cung zad 'phags pa'i steng du pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang / 'dab ma rnams dang phyi'i 'khor yug rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ der nam bcu las dbus su chu bdag wa ru ṇa dkar po/ shar du mtha' yas dkar po/ lhor 'jog po dmar po/ nub tu stobs kyi rgyu nag po/ byang du rigs ldan dkar po/ mer nor rgyas ser po/ bden bral du dung skyong ser po/ rlung du pad+ma dmar po/ dbang ldan du chu lha dkar po/ de rnams kyi mdun du gtsug na rin chen ljang khu ste thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ stod lha'i lus can thal mo sbyar ba/ kha dog dag pa'i shel ltar dwangs shing yul gyi dbang po sna tshogs su snang ba/ spyi gtsug yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang bcas pa'i sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan zhing / smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ g.yon phyogs nas rang dang 'dra ba'i chung mas bsten pa dang bcas pa gsal b.ragyur/ rang gi thugs kha'i hrīḥlas 'od bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas 'dod pa'i khams na gnas pa'i klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad dang / khyad par du yan lag nying lag nyams shing nad pa'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad oṃ e h+yai nā ga sa pa ri wa ra sa mā dzaḥ

dmigs yul gyi klu gnyan yod na khyad par du yang sa bdag klu gnyan 'di zhes pa sogs 'jug go /gang ltar gong gi sa mā dzaḥ'i rjes su 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ bat+ta li bat+ta li mahā bat+ta li hūm̐ hūm̐ dza dza swāhā/ ting shags dkrol te/ oṃ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu/ /pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang / /dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan dang / /lha mo lha mo chen mo dang / /zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che/ /dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang / /sog ma med dang hu lun+ta/ /dga' bo dang ni nye dga' bo/ /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang / /tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang / /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od chen po/ /rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang / /lto 'phye chen po tshi li dang / /tshi li chen po rnams dang ni/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ā gats+tsha ya/ ā gats+tsha ya mahā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye sarba bhu bhur+bhu ba phrum̐ phrum̐ phu hūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod pas mdun du byon par bsam/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ klu rnams kyi mtha' mar 'od kyi lcags ris bskor nas gtor ma bsngos ma zin gyi bar la phyir 'gro sa med par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam pa ni klu'i 'khu ldog mi yong ba'i gdams pa yin no/ /de nas pad+ma ka ma la ya satwam̐ gyis gdan phul/ oṃ mahā nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wa ra ar+gham̐ nas dai wi d+yam̐ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni/ /sa 'og mun pa mtha' dag sel mdzad cing / /bstan la rab dga' sprul pa bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ de nas sa tsa ra dza'i spos zhes pa/ mar gsar dang spos dkar spang spos gsum bsres pa'i sbyar spos bsreg cing lag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas la/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'o ma lta bu phyag g.yas pa'i mthil dang /

sor mo lnga nas babs pas sngar gyi rgya mtsho dang 'dres shing dbyer med du gyur te/ sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad rgya mtsho la bab cing 'thung zhing khrus byas pas/ nad dang du khaḥsdig sgrib thams cad dag yan lag dang nying lag la sogs pa'i dbang po thams cad tshang / bkrag dang gzi mdangs phun sum tshogs par bskyed/ gang la gang 'dod kyi tshul du 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la sogs pa longs spyod pa'i dbang thob nas lha'i lus lta bur gyur pas mnyes shing tshim par gyur/ ces dang / oṃ bā su ke mam̐ swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di brgya stong sogs bzlas la/ ting shags dkrol zhing / oṃ mtha' yas dang ni 'jog po dang / /stobs kyi rgyu dang rigs ldan dang / /nor rgyas dang ni dung skyong dang / /pad+ma dang ni chu lha dang / /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang / /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od chen po/ /klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen sogs/ /klu chen 'khor bcas gtor ma bzhes/ /mdzes pa'i dkar gsum gtor ma 'di/ /mngar gsum 'o ma'i rgya mtsho che/ /rin chen phreng ba'i them skas can/ /klu yi gnod pa skyob byed pa/ /mthun pa'i rdzas su 'di gyur cig /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /klu las gyur pa'i gnod pa ni/ /mthong ba'i dug dang reg pa'i dug /bsam ngan dug dang kha rlangs dug /de la sogs pa'i dug rnams kun/ /yud tsam gyis ni zhi gyur cig /bdag pas gces pa'i rdzas khyer la/ /bdag la gnod pa ma byed cig /ces dang / khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob rnams dang / sbyin bdag yod na 'di zhes bya bas tshe 'dir brag gnyan bshig pa/ shing gnyan bcad pa/ sa gnyan brkos pa/ chu gnyan dkrugs pa sogs la brten pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag zha long 'theng gsum du gyur pa dang / gzhan yang nya dang / rus sbal/ sbal pa/ sbrul dang / lcong mo dang / sdig pa ra tsa/ sdom kha brgyad/ grog mo sogs la gnod bskyal bas/ klu gnyan sa bdag khyed rnams kyi thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa thams cad bshags shing /

bdud rtsi khrus kyi rdzing bur/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po dang / klu nad thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi 'o ma'i rgyun lta bu char bzhin babs pas/ de la sa bdag klu gnyan zha long 'theng gsum du gyur pa rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad kyis 'thung zhing khrus byas pas/ lus kyi zug rngu dang / sems kyi sdug bsngal gnod byed kyi bsam pa'i gdug rtsub zhi nas/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i sdig sgrib dag ste/ lus dang yan lag dang / nying lag dang dbang po rnams nyams pa thams cad tshang zhing sos nas sngar bas kyang lhag pa/ lha'i lus lta bur gyur te mnyes shing tshim nas bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la longs spyod par gyur cig gzhan yang bdag cag dpon slob/ sbyin bdag yod na de 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas lan chags shing sha 'khon du gnyer ba rnams la yid du 'ong ba'i gnas dang / zas dang / longs spyod dang ldan par gyur cig mdze dang / shu ba dang / yan lag dang / nying lag nyams pa la sogs pa'i nad thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig khyed rnams mkha' lding gi gnod pa thams cad dang bral nas byang chub kyi lam thob par gyur cig gnod sems zhi nas byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig gzhan yang spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hriḥyig gi 'od kyis rin po che'i brag ri dang / gser gyi bya skyibs la sogs pa'i gnas dang / bdud rtsi 'o ma lta bu'i mtsho dang / khrus kyi rdzing bu ne'u gsing / klu'i pho brang / skyed mos tshal la sogs pa sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad dga' bar byed pa'i mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pas chu bdag wa ru ṇa dang / klu chen po brgyad kyis gtso byas pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag gi rigs thams cad tshim zhing mnyes nas bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la longs spyod par gyur cig ces brjod/ de nas gong bshams pa'i gtor theb gnyis kyi nang gi ril bu brgyad tshan dang po/

oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsang / oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭ kyis bdud rtsir gyur par bsam/ oṃ a kā ro mu kham̐ sarba dharmā ṇa ā d+ya nut+pan+na twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam/ dpe 'ga' zhig tu skabs 'dir gtor mgron spyan 'dren bshad kyang / 'dir ma bshad pa ni gong du byas pa des don tshang bas log rtog can rnams kyis ma go ba'i gtam ma smra zhig de nas klu dga' ba'i phyag rgya ni lag pa g.yon khu tshur byas pa'i mthe bong dang / mthe chung bsgrengs/ g.yas kyi sor mo rnams sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka ltar brkyangs pa g.yon gyi mthe bong gi steng du gdugs phub pa ltar sbyar la/ ngag tu/ oṃ hi li hi li mahā hi li phrum̐ phrum̐ swāhā/ oṃ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha dzum̐ phrum̐ phu hūm̐ swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags tshan gnyis po gtor snod re re la lan gsum gsum brjod pas phul/ de'ang gtor theb gnyis su dus re la bsngos tshar ba dang / skabs 'dir rang ngam grogs kyis gtor theb gnyis kyi zan ril brgyad 'o ma chu dang bcas pa bdud rtsi khrus kyi rdzing bu'am klu gnas pa'i chu mig sogs su dor la ril bu brgyad tshan brgyad ma rdzogs bar ril bu gsar ba bsham zhing gong bzhin sbyong ba yin/ ting shags dkrol te/ klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis gtso byas pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag gi rigs thams cad dang / khyad par du bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la gnod cing lan chags pa'i 'khon du gnyer ba'i klu gnyan sa bdag gi rigs thams cad la sbyin no/ /gtor ma 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho chen po 'dis tshim zhing mnyes nas gnod pa gdug pa'i bsam pa zhi nas/ phan pa dang zhi ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig ces brjod/ gong gi sngags tshan gnyis po lan re brjod pa dang /

se gol re gdab bo/ /yang rang ngam sbyin bdag la gnod pa'i ming gsal can gyi klu gnyan yod na gzhan gong bzhin las de'i ming nas brjod pa sogs skabs thob dang sbyar/ de nas ril bu brgyad tshan gnyis pa man gyi byin rlabs oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs la/ 'bul tshul klu dga' ba'i phyag rgya bca' ba nas bzung 'phrin las 'chol ba'i bar yan sngar bzhin brjod/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis zan ril brgyad tshan brgyad du bcad de gtor theb gnyis gnyis dus re la 'bul zhing / yongs dril 'bul thengs brgyad bya ste/ de yang tshan pa re re la gtor theb gnyis gnyis su gcod pa ni klu brgyad gtso bor gyur pa'i ril bu brgyad 'byung ba la dgongs shing / tshan pa brgyad 'bul ba ni klu brgyad po re re la'ang ril bu brgyad brgyad phul te yongs dril zan ril drug bcu rtsa bzhi rdzogs par 'bul ba la dgongs pa yin no/ /yang gtor chung drug cu rtsa bzhi byas kyang rung bar gsungs shing / gong du gtor snod re la sngags lan gsum gsum brjod par bshad pa ni chos rgyal 'phags pa'i dgongs pa yin la/ spyir ril bu brgya sngags gcig gis bsngo ru yang rung zhing / de bzhin ril bu gcig sngags brgyas bsngo ru yang rung bar gsungs so/ /de ltar tshan pa brgyad phul tshar ba dang / gtor theb rnams chu dang 'o ma bsres pas bkang la/ chu sbyin bsdus pa 'di bya ste/ oṃ dz+nyā na a ba lo ke te na ma sa man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa mahā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da dz+wa la swāhā/ chu'i sbyin pa rgya chen po 'di la brten nas klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / 'jog po nyer dga' bo la sogs pa srid pa chu klung gi bdag po rnams kyi rgyud la sbyin pa dam pa sems kyi rgyan/ sems kyi yo byad rnal 'byor gyi tshogs/ don gyi mchog rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skabs dang ldan par gyur cig

de nas/ klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dgyes shing phyag gnyis thugs khar thal mo sbyar te bdag rnams kyis las ci bgyi/ zhes sgrub pa po la klu rnams nyan pa'i tshul du gnas par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ theg pa thun mong gi chos bshad pa ni/ ting shags dkrol ba dang / chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /zhes pa nas/ 'on kyang skyobs pa'i sras su skyes/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod pas chos kyi sbyin pa byin nas/ de ltar na chos dang zing zing gi sbyin pa 'di'i mthu la brten nas klu'i rgyal po chu bdag wa ru ṇa la sogs pa'i klu rgyal rigs rje rigs/ dmangs rigs/ khyim bdag gi rigs/ gdol pa can gyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad kyi lus dang longs spyod nyams pa thams cad sos par gyur cig tshe dang dbang thang thams cadྎ dpal dang grags pa thams cadྎ mthu dang stobs thams cadྎ bkrag dang gzi mdangs thams cadྎ khrag dang chu ser thams cadྎ skyi dang pags pa thams cadྎ dbang po dang don snying thams cadྎ yan lag dang nying lag thams cadྎ gnas dang 'khor nyams pa thams cad sos par gyur cig klu rnams la nam mkha' lding dang bye tshan gyi gnod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig bdag cag dpon slob rnams dang / sbyin bdag yod na de 'khor bcas pa dang / sems can thams cad la sa bdag klu gnyan gyi gnod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig mi 'byung bar gyur cig 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa/ char chu dus su phebs pa/ mi nad dang phyugs nad rgyun chad par gyur cig ces dang / rang gi snying kha'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas/ klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la phog pas rkyen byas/ de dag gi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sa bdag klu gnyan la sogs pa'i nyer 'tshe sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur/ ces brjod cing / na mo rat+na dra yā ya/ oṃ kam̐ ka ni sogs bdun nam nyer gcig sogs bzlas la/

de nas smon lam gdab pa ni/ klu yi rigs ni khyed rnams kun/ /sems dang shes pa gsal gyur cig /drin lan dam tshig dran gyis la/ /bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ /shin tu khros pa zhi gyur cig /dbang po rnams kyi spyod yul du/ /mkho dgu'i longs spyod thams cad ldan/ /nyams pa'i lus 'di sos gyur cig /yan lag thams cad bde gyur cig /ngan song gsum las thar nas kyang / /tshangs pa'i bde dang ldan gyur cig /chos spyod dbang po dul nas kyang / /phyag na rdo rje'i zhal mthong shog /'jig pa kun las skyabs gyur cig /longs spyod chen po thob gyur cig /ces brjod/ de nas yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /sogs kyis lhag chad kha bskangs/ sngar gyi 'od kyi lcags ri de mi dmigs par bsam nas/ sman dang sngags sogs byin rlabs kyis/ /nad dang nyer 'tshe kun spangs nas/ /drin lan dam tshig dran gyis la/ /rang rang gnas su 'gro bar gyis/ /oṃ mahā nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wa ra gats+tshaḥzhes pas ye shes pa gshegs shing dam tshig pa rnams mi dmigs par gyur par bsam la/ se gol lag pa gnyis ka phyir bstan du brdab bo/ /de nas rang gi lag pa gnyis rgyab sbyar mthe'u chung sbrel mthe bong gnyis lag mthil du bkug sor mo lhag ma rnams gshibs te cung zad thur du brkyangs pa bya khyung gi phyag rgya bcas la/ ga ru ḍa ham̐ sa he tsa le tsa le swāhā/ zhes brjod pas bdag bsrung zhing klu nag po thams cad bskrad par bsam/ de nas/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs dang / dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /sogs kyis bsngo ba dang smon lam bkra shis rgyas par bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ gtor ma rnams dang 'o ma sogs gong gi mchod rdzas de rnams klu gnas pa'i chu mig gam sa gtsang sar dor la/ de nas rang nyid grogs dang bcas pas mdo gnam sa snang brgyad dang / klu'i dpang skong sogs tshar mang du klog cing gtor ma brgya rtsa chag med byed bzhin pa yin na skabs 'dir byas na shin tu legs par mngon no/

/bdag gi bla ma sems dpa' chen po grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid chab gtor klu gtor 'di rnams gnang skabs snga bar bzhengs te/ thugs dam gtor ma'i nyams bzhes la 'jug par mdzad cing / de ma grub bar la dmar skyur gyi rigs zhal la mi reg pas 'di shin tu gal che bas rjes 'jug kun gyis las sla bla bcos su ma song ba zhig cis kyang mdzad 'tshal/ zhes klu gtor gtong tshul gyi yi ge dgos 'dod char 'bebs zhes bya ba 'di ni rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i don bzhin chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa'i gsung rab kyi dgongs pa ltar/ sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i gsal byed sgron me dang / rje thar rtse nas nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i yig cha gzhir bzhag cung zad mi gsal ba rnams sems dpa' chen po sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyis klu gtor gnang ba'i phyag len mang du mthong bas brgyan te/ lug lo zla ba lnga pa'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes la/ dpal sa skya'i gnas mchog chu mig rdzing kha'i bla brang bde mchog pho brang gi yang rtse e wam̐ byang chub 'byung ba'i gnas sam/ kun gsal bde chen pho brang zhes kyang bya ba'i skyed mos tshal gyi khur rgyan dben gnas dam pa de nyid du shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong rigs sngags 'chang ba byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya bas legs par bris pa'i yi ge pa yang rang nyid kyis bgyis so/ /'dis kyang sems can dpag tu med pa la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig thams cad bkra shis par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge'o// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 10 a myes zhabs/ klu gtor gtong tshul gyi yi ge dgos 'dod char 'bebs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 9
